limitations: Every confidence interval is exploratory and unadjusted for multiple model/category comparisons.

The 536 games are chronological validation, not an untouched final test. Standalone coefficients train before July 2025; lagged features update using earlier completed games. Full-game models refit before each cohort, so earlier validation games may enter later chronological training. No game uses its own future outcome. Later ablations reuse the nine-game development sample.
No verified historical executable player-prop lines were available; threshold diagnostics are not betting records.
No original publication archives for historical injuries/lineups/weather; no production promotion is authorized by these results.

resources.accounting: Research runner CPU only; small audits, test suites, interpreter startup and packaging are reported separately, not included in this total.
resources.projectionMemory: Whole-process peak was not recorded. One live RSS sample was 1850972 KiB; do not interpret the full-game-only maximum as the experiment maximum.

stop: Predeclared validation cohorts and bounded structural hypotheses completed. Promotion blocked by reliability/coverage and source-availability gates; no further parameter sweeps scheduled.
